blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — The provincial government of Pangasinan iw appealing to the public to give information on a reported child exploitation, abuse and other unlawful activities in a house in this city. In a statement on Friday (Oct. 30), the provincial government said it was communicating with the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), Philippine National Police (PNP) and National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) about the matter. The Urdaneta City Police Station (UCPS) made the same call.
